title: Actions related to transmission of DedicatedSIBRequest message

entities.name: Dedicated SIB Request procedure
entities.description: Procedure where the UE requests specific system information blocks (SIBs) or positioning SIBs (posSIBs) from the network.

entities.name: DedicatedSIBRequest message
entities.description: Message sent by UE to request specific system information blocks from the network.

entities.name: requestedSIB-List
entities.description: Information element that indicates the requested SIB(s) in the onDemandSIB-RequestList.

entities.name: requestedPosSIB-List
entities.description: Information element that indicates the requested positioning SIB(s) in the onDemandSIB-RequestList.

entities.name: onDemandSIB-RequestList
entities.description: Container information element that holds either requestedSIB-List or requestedPosSIB-List.

entities.name: Procedure triggered to request required SIB(s)
entities.description: Condition where the procedure is triggered to request regular system information blocks.

entities.name: Procedure triggered to request required posSIB(s)
entities.description: Condition where the procedure is triggered to request positioning system information blocks.

entities.name: Submit message to lower layers for transmission
entities.description: Action where the UE submits the DedicatedSIBRequest message to lower layers for transmission.

relations.description: The Dedicated SIB Request procedure includes transmission of the DedicatedSIBRequest message.
The DedicatedSIBRequest message contains the onDemandSIB-RequestList IE.
The onDemandSIB-RequestList contains requestedSIB-List when requesting regular SIBs.
The onDemandSIB-RequestList contains requestedPosSIB-List when requesting positioning SIBs.
The condition of requesting regular SIBs guards the inclusion of requestedSIB-List.
The condition of requesting positioning SIBs guards the inclusion of requestedPosSIB-List.
The procedure includes submitting the message to lower layers for transmission.
